profile.headline: Engineer
profile.summary:
Engineering professional with versatile and progressive experience in combination of QA test, software development, and system engineering.

•	6 years in software QA engineer; manual test and automation test development combined (NYAB, Presagis, and Tinker AFB)
•	5+ years in simulation (Presagis and Tinker AFB)
•	2 years in system engineer (Tinker AFB)
•	3+ years in software engineer (Tinker AFB).

positions.title: Electronics Engineer/Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on embedded avionic graphic display system.
Led re-host software from VAPS to IData. Multi-systems integration testing.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer/Simulation
positions.description: Maintenance the Pilot Simulation software included converting information display modules from AVID to IData software, adding new functionalities, fixing existing defects, and developing new software interface.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer/System Engineer
positions.description:
Analyzed/update milestone requirements document, systems requirements documents, and ICD.
Wrote test cases and analysis reports.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer/Test Program Set Developer
positions.description: Developed automatic test program set for circuit boards.

positions.title: Engineering Technician/3rd Herd Communication Support
positions.description:
Troubleshot and supported computer issues for more than 200 users.
Installed PC softwares/hardware upgrade.
